title: OpenAI proposes a solution to the Navier–Stokes problem
summary: OpenAI announces a proof that three-dimensional solutions to the Navier–Stokes equations can develop a singularity in finite time and publishes a text formalized in Lean. This is the source's claim: this record does not establish community consensus, correctness of the artifacts, or recognition as a Millennium Prize problem.

evidence.tested: OpenAI shared an analytical proof and a Lean formalization that an initially smooth fluid at rest can develop a finite-time singularity under a smooth force with finite energy.
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material
evidence.ai_role: An internal OpenAI model, described as more capable than GPT-6 Astra, produced the proof and the Lean formalization.
